repos.name: TerraDBAssist

repos.name: BCBSLegislativePulse
repos.rationale: Empty repo (no commits).

repos.name: mass-valuation-showcase
repos.description: Interactive showcase of quantum-powered Mass Valuation Appraisal Suite (CostForge 3-6-9 framework, built with Manus)
repos.rationale: Showcase/demo. Mass valuation capabilities exist in canonical Forge suite. Archive.

repos.name: legislative-pulse-beacon
repos.rationale: Legislative tracking demo. Not core assessor domain. Archive.

security_concerns: TerraFusion_BentonCounty: .env committed to PUBLIC repo + 11MB .exe binary — make private before archive
summary.key_finding: No predecessor/showcase repo contains unique capabilities not already in the canonical stack. WashingtonForge and TaxI_AI (classified in Phase 4M) are the only repos with high unique value. terrafusion-website is kept as the live public-facing marketing site.
